scope@1.response:
I've completed the scoped assessment. Here's the outcome.

## Environment reality (recorded, not worked around)
- **Writes are permitted only under `.rust-queue/reports/`.** Repository source, the `.rust-queue/` root, shell, `grep`, and `web_fetch` all return the same boundary error. So the source patch is **drafted, not applied**, no command was executed, and live issue/PR activity could not be re-fetched.
- **`.rust-queue/reports/native-check-summary.json` is absent** (searched repo-wide), so there is no trusted native evidence for this run.

## What the issue requires and what I found
Issue #781 asks only: create a Rust ABI type for `MethodInArgPtr`, referenced to C++, like `SamplePtr`. There is **no** Rust `MethodInArgPtr` at baseline (all `*.rs` enumerated; the FFI bridge covers events/samples only).

I bound the layout to the **actual C++ representation** in `score/mw/com/impl/methods/method_signature_element_ptr.h` — `MethodInArgPtr<T> = MethodSignatureElementPtr<T>` with members `SignatureElement* element_ptr_; bool& ptr_active_; std::size_t queue_position_;` → Rust `*mut T` / `*mut bool` / `usize` (24 B, align 8, independent of `T`). I did **not** reuse the `SamplePtr` variant layout. I also captured the move-only + destructor-clears-`ptr_active_` ownership semantics as an open FFI obligation.

## Deliverables (in `.rust-queue/reports/`)
- **`scope.md`** — binding, authority/limits, bound C++ representation, proposed change set, open prerequisites, verification status.
- **`check-plan.json`** — 9 pending checks, all BUILD-derived labels on `linux_x64`, no shell commands:
  - query `//score/mw/com/impl/methods:method_signature_element_ptr`
  - build `.../plumbing/rust:method_in_arg_ptr_rs` (proposed), `.../test_support:test_helper_size_provider`
  - test `.../plumbing/rust:method_in_arg_ptr_test_rs` (proposed) plus regressions `sample_ptr_test_rs`, `sample_allocatee_ptr_test_rs`, `//score/mw/com/impl/methods:method_signature_element_ptr_test`
  - docs `.../plumbing/rust:method_in_arg_ptr_doc_test` (proposed, `rust_doc_test` convention)
  - lint `.../plumbing/rust:method_in_arg_ptr_rs` under `clippy_strict`
- **`review-packet.md`** — acceptance trace, the exact drafted patch (new `method_in_arg_ptr.rs`, BUILD wiring, C++ `TestSizeProvider` size/align accessors, FFI declarations, test-support dep), verification table (all not-run), offline decisions, and manifest caveats (hashes unavailable).
- **`_probe.txt`** — unavoidable write-capability probe artifact (could not be deleted).

## Pending / open (preserved)
1. Placement of the mirror (`impl/plumbing/rust` proposed vs new `impl/methods/rust`).
2. `Send`/thread-transfer contract (intentionally omitted vs `SamplePtr`).
3. Ownership/destruction across FFI for the move-only C++ type.
4. `MethodReturnTypePtr` coverage out of scope.
5. All native checks unexecuted; **engineering acceptance pending offline human decision.**

Because only `reports/` is writable, `scope.md` and `check-plan.json` could not be placed directly under `.rust-queue/` as the brief implied; both attempts were rejected by the boundary and this is documented in the packet.

agent_tools.name: close_agent
agent_tools.description: Close a running or completed subagent that is no longer needed.

agent_tools.name: edit_file
agent_tools.description: Edit a file by replacing an exact string. The old_string must be an exact match and unique unless replace_all is true; include surrounding context when needed. Read the file first and preserve existing indentation.

agent_tools.name: glob
agent_tools.description: Find files by search-root-relative path using a glob pattern. Use path to choose the search root. `*` stays within one path segment and `**` searches recursively. Patterns match files, so a trailing `/` is rejected. Prefer this over shell find or ls when locating repository files.

agent_tools.name: grep
agent_tools.description: Search file contents with a regex pattern. Use path to choose the search root, glob_filter to limit matching files, case_insensitive for case folding, and max_results to cap output.

agent_tools.name: read_file
agent_tools.description: Read files before editing them. Returns line-numbered text and supports offset/limit for large files. Use this instead of shell cat, head, tail, or sed when inspecting repository files.

agent_tools.name: request_user_input
agent_tools.description: Ask the human one or more questions and wait for their answers before continuing this stage.

agent_tools.name: send_input
agent_tools.description: Send a follow-up message to a subagent. A running agent receives it at a safe turn boundary. A completed agent starts another turn in the same session with its existing history.

agent_tools.name: shell
agent_tools.description: Execute Bash commands for terminal operations, package managers, tests and builds. Use dedicated tools for file reads, file edits, filename searches, and content searches. Provide timeout_ms for long-running commands.

agent_tools.name: spawn_agent
agent_tools.description: Spawn a subagent for independent work or context isolation. Use it for tasks that can proceed separately, and avoid duplicating the same work in the parent session.

agent_tools.name: update_plan
agent_tools.description: Update the multi-step plan for the current task. Submit the entire plan; existing steps are reconciled by exact step text.

agent_tools.name: wait
agent_tools.description: Wait for a subagent to complete, then use the result to synthesize the outcome for the user. Omit agent_id to wait for every running subagent at once.

agent_tools.name: web_fetch
agent_tools.description: Fetch content from a URL that starts with http:// or https://. Pass a prompt to extract specific information or summarize the page; omit prompt to return the page content.

agent_tools.name: write_file
agent_tools.description: Create new files, or overwrite an existing file only when replacement is explicitly intended. Prefer edit_file for targeted changes to existing files because write_file overwrites the full file content.

draft@1.response:
I've completed the issue-scoped implementation. Summary:

## What changed

**New Rust ABI mirror** — `score/mw/com/impl/plumbing/rust/method_in_arg_ptr.rs`
- `#[repr(C)] pub struct MethodInArgPtr<T> { _element_ptr: *mut T, _ptr_active: *mut bool, _queue_position: usize }` bound **directly** to the real C++ `MethodSignatureElementPtr<T>` member order in `score/mw/com/impl/methods/method_signature_element_ptr.h` (member order `SignatureElement*`, `bool&`, `std::size_t`; ref → `*mut bool`), not inferred from `SamplePtr`.
- Manual `Debug`; layout-only semantics documented (no `Drop`/`Send`, since the C++ type is move-only and its destructor clears the caller-owned flag).
- `#[cfg(test)]` size/align tests vs the C++ `sizeof`/`alignof`, following the `SamplePtr`/`SampleAllocateePtr` pattern.

**Build wiring**
- `plumbing/rust/BUILD`: added `rust_doc_test` load + `method_in_arg_ptr_rs` (rust_library), `method_in_arg_ptr_test_rs` (rust_unit_test, `link_std_cpp_lib`), `method_in_arg_ptr_doc_test`.
- `test_support/BUILD`: added dep `//score/mw/com/impl/methods:method_signature_element_ptr` (visibility-compatible).

**Rust↔C++ size/align verification helper**
- `test_helper_size_provider.h/.cpp`: `GetMethodInArgPtrInt32Size`/`GetMethodInArgPtrUserDefinedTypeSize` plus `extern "C"` wrappers.
- `test_helper_size_ffi.rs`: two FFI declarations + `MethodInArgPtrLola` provider.

Licenses/SPDX headers, pins and lint policy untouched; no dependency upgrades, Cargo scaffolding or lint suppressions.

**Report** — `.rust-queue/reports/implementation.md` lists every changed path, the bound C++ layout evidence, verification status and unresolved concerns.

## Verification status
No native command ran (shell/bazel blocked); all 9 checks in `check-plan.json` remain **pending**, `native-check-summary.json` is still absent, and engineering acceptance is a **pending offline human decision**.

## Unresolved concerns (documented, not decided here)
FFI ownership/destruction of the move-only, flag-clearing C++ type; mirror placement (`plumbing/rust` proposal vs `impl/methods/rust`); `Send` contract; `MethodReturnTypePtr` out of scope; requirements/design impact unknown. Prior scope artifacts (`scope.md`, `review-packet.md`, `check-plan.json`, `_probe.txt`) were preserved as history.
